ios.desc:
Discover Good Vibes Notifications, your ultimate tool for 100% personalized notifications.

PRODUCT HUNT : Good VIbes Notifications is now Product of the Week (Health & Fitness category)

Create notifications that boost you for the day or prank your friends. With Good Vibes Notifications, every detail matters and you have total control.

Total? Yes, completely total!

Limitless customization:

Choose the title, subtitle, and content of each notification for a completely tailor-made experience.

Express your visual identity by selecting the icon that best represents the context in which you want to receive your notification.

Icing on the notification :

Insert images into your notifications to give even more credibility to your creations.

A wanted notification:

With Good Vibes Notifications, you won't be disturbed at a bad time. You will receive a notification scheduled by you at the time you want to receive a notification to boost you or remind you of the goals you have set for yourself.

Daily motivation:

Positive reminders are one of the simplest and most powerful ways to promote mental development.

Cultivate positive thoughts from the start of the day, which provides you with accessible mental reserves on difficult days when you need them most. Good Vibes Notifications helps you get your dose of positivity in your daily life without needing to be reminded.

A notification for fun:

Play a joke on a friend by customizing a notification that he will be impossible not to believe!

Simple and Intuitive:

An interface that makes creating notifications as simple as it takes only 30 seconds to create a notification.
No need for advanced technical skills.

Attention! notifications are only sent to yourself and do not actually come from a person. The amounts displayed in the case of payment notifications are not real amounts, likewise for sales. Entertainment and good vibes are the sole purpose of this application.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Create your own personalized notifications on mobile

quotes.text:
Hello HN,

YouTube videos about entrepreneurship and even my friends were telling me that autosuggestion is a strong psychological technique to make my thoughts come true.

I decided to use Reminders or Calendar on my mobile to help me do that regularly. 
However, I found that notifications from those apps are not very suitable for my practice.

So, I decided to build Good Vibes Notifications to allow me to create a notification from scratch.

With the tool you can :
 - Set up your title and subtitle
 - Write your message  
 - Choose the icon associated with the notification 
 - Schedule when you want to receive your notification 
 - Decide if it's a periodic or one-time notification

During the development, I found that could be a funny tool too for pranking friends .

Available on iOS and Android
